fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Maharishi University MUIT Lucknow and Noida Campus has invited online applications for the UG, PG and Diploma Courses Admissions 2026 on the official website of the MUIT recently. Online registration process for MUIT Admission 2025 has started from 15 March 2026. The last date to apply for the MUIT Admission 2025 is 15 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MUIT Admission Online Form 2026 which has given below.

Maharishi University MUIT Lucknow and Noida Campus

MUIT Admissions Online Form 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 March 2026
  • Last Date : 15 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 July 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS Candidates : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST Candidates : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

MUIT Admissions Online Form 2026 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On MUIT Rules.
  • Minimum Age : N/A
  • Maximum Age : N/A
  • Age Relaxation as per MUIT Admission Rules.
  • Use Tool –

MUIT Admissions Online Form 2026 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://www.maharishiuniversity.ac.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the MUIT before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Sarkari Result Notification Here – Check Now.
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for MUIT Admissions Online Form can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.

Documents to be Uploaded for MUIT Admission 2026

  • Recent Passport-Sized Photograph
  • Signature
  • 10th Mark Sheet & Certificate
  • 12th Mark Sheet & Certificate (if applicable)
  • Graduation Mark Sheet & Certificate (for PG courses)
  • Category Certificate (if applicable)
  • Domicile Certificate (if required)
  • ID Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, etc.)

MUIT Application Form 2026 : Mode of Selection

  • Entrance Test
  • Merit Based Selection
  • Counselling
  • Final Admission

Answer. Online applications for this application form have started from 15 March 2026.

Q. What is Last Date of MUIT Admissions Notification 2026?
Answer. The last date to apply online for this application form is 15 July 2026.

Q. What is Age Limit For MUIT Admission 2026?
Answer. The age of the candidates applying for this application form as per
MUIT rules, see the post wise age information in the official information.

Q. What is Qualification For MUIT Admissions Application Form 2026?
Answer. To apply for this application form, the candidate must have 12th pass read the official information completely before applying.

Q. How to Apply For MUIT Admissions Online Form 2026?
Answer. To apply for this application form, first of all you have to go to the Official Sarkari Result which is SarkariExam.com and apply through this recruitment page. Through Sarkari Result Official you can apply for many government jobs.

Q. How to download the result of MUIT Admissions Result 2026?
Answer. All those candidates who had given the exam for this application form can now download their result. To download your result, you can download it by entering registration number / roll number and DOB (Date of Birth). The official download link of the result will be made available in the important links above.

Q. What is MUIT Official Website?
Answer. The Official Website of MUIT is https://www.maharishiuniversity.ac.in/
